#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --job-name=cp2k-overlay-sync-probe
#SBATCH --account=proj-sai-hpc-software
#SBATCH --partition=DSPRHBM
#SBATCH --qos=rush-cpu
#SBATCH --nodes=1
#SBATCH --ntasks=1
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=2
#SBATCH --mem=8G
#SBATCH --time=20
#SBATCH --export=NIL
#SBATCH --chdir=/org/org-open-sai/proj-sai-hpc-software/runs/cp2k-overlay-sync-probe-20261025
#SBATCH --output=/org/org-open-sai/proj-sai-hpc-software/runs/cp2k-overlay-sync-probe-20261025/results/slurm-%j.log
set -eo pipefail
export PATH=/usr/bin:/bin LD_LIBRARY_PATH="" LD_PRELOAD=""
source /etc/profile.d/lmod.sh
module load apptainer/1.4.4
export TMPDIR=/org/org-open-sai/proj-sai-hpc-software/runs/cp2k-overlay-sync-probe-20261025/runtime
export APPTAINER_TMPDIR="$TMPDIR" APPTAINER_CACHEDIR=/org/org-open-sai/proj-sai-hpc-software/runs/cp2k-overlay-sync-probe-20261025/apptainer-cache
apptainer overlay create --fakeroot --sparse --size 512 /org/org-open-sai/proj-sai-hpc-software/runs/cp2k-overlay-sync-probe-20261025/work.ext3
/usr/bin/python3 /org/org-open-sai/proj-sai-hpc-software/controller/9654ff1f2187c1c2db3d9fcb37a860859ca13bdd/cp2k-dsprhbm-sync-recovery-20261025-1db19ea511d1/cp2k_image_driver.py /org/org-open-sai/proj-sai-hpc-software /org/org-open-sai/proj-sai-hpc-software/runs/cp2k-overlay-sync-probe-20261025 exec --bind /org/org-open-sai/proj-sai-hpc-software/runs/cp2k-overlay-sync-probe-20261025/results:/results:rw --fakeroot --cleanenv --containall --no-home --no-mount bind-paths,home,cwd,tmp,hostfs --pwd / --net --network none --bind /usr:/usr:ro --bind /sbin:/sbin:ro --bind /lib:/lib:ro --bind /lib64:/lib64:ro --bind /opt/devtools:/opt/devtools:ro --bind /opt/modules:/opt/modules:ro --bind /etc/profile.d/lmod.sh:/etc/profile.d/lmod.sh:ro --bind /etc/lmod:/etc/lmod:ro --bind /org/org-open-sai/proj-sai-hpc-software/controller/9654ff1f2187c1c2db3d9fcb37a860859ca13bdd/cp2k-dsprhbm-sync-recovery-20261025-1db19ea511d1:/control:ro --overlay /org/org-open-sai/proj-sai-hpc-software/runs/cp2k-overlay-sync-probe-20261025/work.ext3 --env BUILD_JOBS=2 --env TMPDIR=/workspace/tmp /org/org-open-sai/proj-sai-hpc-software/containers/base/minimal-v1.sif /usr/bin/python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path
import concurrent.futures,hashlib,json,sys
sys.path.insert(0,'"'"'/control'"'"')
from cp2k_overlay_sync import synchronize
root=Path('"'"'/workspace/sync-probe'"'"');root.mkdir(parents=True)
def write(n):
 folder=root/str(n//128);folder.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
 path=folder/(str(n)+'"'"'.tmp'"'"');path.write_bytes((str(n)+'"'"'\n'"'"').encode()*256)
 path.rename(folder/(str(n)+'"'"'.dat'"'"'))
with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=4) as pool:list(pool.map(write,range(4096)))
for path in list(root.rglob('"'"'*.dat'"'"'))[::3]:path.unlink()
manifest={str(p.relative_to(root)):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in root.rglob('"'"'*.dat'"'"')}
Path('"'"'/results/manifest.json'"'"').write_text(json.dumps(manifest))
synchronize('"'"'dependencies'"'"')
print('"'"'SYNC_PROBE_FILES'"'"',len(manifest),flush=True)
'
/usr/sbin/e2fsck -fn /org/org-open-sai/proj-sai-hpc-software/runs/cp2k-overlay-sync-probe-20261025/work.ext3 > results/fsck.stdout 2> results/fsck.stderr
sha256sum work.ext3 > results/before.sha256
/usr/bin/python3 /org/org-open-sai/proj-sai-hpc-software/controller/9654ff1f2187c1c2db3d9fcb37a860859ca13bdd/cp2k-dsprhbm-sync-recovery-20261025-1db19ea511d1/cp2k_image_driver.py /org/org-open-sai/proj-sai-hpc-software /org/org-open-sai/proj-sai-hpc-software/runs/cp2k-overlay-sync-probe-20261025 exec --bind /org/org-open-sai/proj-sai-hpc-software/runs/cp2k-overlay-sync-probe-20261025/results:/results:rw --fakeroot --cleanenv --containall --no-home --no-mount bind-paths,home,cwd,tmp,hostfs --pwd / --net --network none --bind /usr:/usr:ro --bind /sbin:/sbin:ro --bind /lib:/lib:ro --bind /lib64:/lib64:ro --bind /opt/devtools:/opt/devtools:ro --bind /opt/modules:/opt/modules:ro --bind /etc/profile.d/lmod.sh:/etc/profile.d/lmod.sh:ro --bind /etc/lmod:/etc/lmod:ro --bind /org/org-open-sai/proj-sai-hpc-software/controller/9654ff1f2187c1c2db3d9fcb37a860859ca13bdd/cp2k-dsprhbm-sync-recovery-20261025-1db19ea511d1:/control:ro --overlay /org/org-open-sai/proj-sai-hpc-software/runs/cp2k-overlay-sync-probe-20261025/work.ext3:ro --env BUILD_JOBS=2 --env TMPDIR=/workspace/tmp /org/org-open-sai/proj-sai-hpc-software/containers/base/minimal-v1.sif /usr/bin/python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json
root=Path('"'"'/workspace/sync-probe'"'"');expected=json.loads(Path('"'"'/results/manifest.json'"'"').read_text())
actual={str(p.relative_to(root)):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in root.rglob('"'"'*.dat'"'"')}
assert expected==actual
Path('"'"'/results/remount.json'"'"').write_text(json.dumps(dict(passed=True,files=len(actual))))
print('"'"'SYNC_PROBE_REMOUNT_PASSED'"'"',len(actual),flush=True)
'
sha256sum --check results/before.sha256
echo CP2K_OVERLAY_SYNC_PROBE_PASSED
